model_family_policy.rationale: Exact runtime model availability cannot be guaranteed inside this preparation environment, so a constrained model-FAMILY policy is fixed here; the operator pins exact runtime model identifiers + versions at freeze/run time (they become part of the frozen record).

family_slots.descriptor: a top-tier frontier judge model (highest-capability family available at run time)
a mid/large model from the SAME vendor family (version-distinct from frontier_A)
a strong model from a DIFFERENT vendor family (cross-vendor robustness; guards against single-vendor bias)

model_family_policy.diversity_requirement: at least one cross-vendor family SHOULD be included; a result carried by a single family is down-weighted by the scorer's no-single-model-family-dominance rule
model_family_policy.note: exact identifiers are intentionally NOT hard-coded here; the operator records them in the frozen run log

run_configuration.temperature_note: deterministic decoding; if a provider forbids 0, use the lowest permitted and record it
run_configuration.system_prompt: You are a careful annotator. Follow the instructions exactly. Answer with a single letter only, optionally followed by a confidence line. Do not explain.

output_schema.arm_left: string (echoed from stimulus; hidden from the model)
output_schema.arm_right: string (echoed from stimulus; hidden from the model)

run_configuration.invalid_handling: if after retries the output is not parseable to A/B -> parse_status set accordingly and invalid_flag=true; NEVER hand-repaired; counted toward the 10% invalid cap
run_configuration.model_ordering: each item judged by every pinned model; model order recorded; results reported per model_id
run_configuration.position_balancing: already baked into stimuli via position_seed (A_real left/right balanced across the 53 objects); the model never sees arm labels
run_configuration.blinding: arm_left/arm_right are NOT shown to the model; they live in the stimulus record for scoring only

non_claims: judge config policy; not a run
exact runtime IDs pinned by operator at freeze
